text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has officially kicked off!
Vodka surveys the grand
sights and deeply
breathes in the smell of the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's race! Whaddya say to a
two-furlong sprint on the sand?
Think you
can match my speed?

text_block_list.name: Older Student
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, who do you think I am? I'm already
G1 material! Do you really
think you'd win
against me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely—with my brand-new "explosive
running" technique! Watch
me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Raaargh! Look at the way I launch off the
sand! Man, this technique's
so cool! I'm
right behind my opponent!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a second. Why is the gap getting
bigger again?! Crap, I can't
close it! G1s
are seriously in a whole 'nother league...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Daaammit! Why?! I could swear I had way
more power!

text_block_list.name: Older Student
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like this is the best you can
do. ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This sucks! Nah, you better watch me. By
the time this camp is over,
I'm gonna be
the king of this beach...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap, I'm doing it again. Trying to
prove how cool I am is totally
backfiring
on me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what's up, Trainer? If you're here to
try and make me feel
better—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Kicking the sand... Oh, you mean my
"explosive running"
technique? But if I
don't kick,
then I can't get enough power...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hang on! I think I got it! Sand is different—if I keep kicking it, I'm actually gonna lose power instead. In that case, I should... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there's a better way to run. Mom
was super fast even on dirt, but she was
never flashy. I bet I can try to pull
something like that off
too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I think I got it... Um, excuse me! Can we
run it back? Please?

text_block_list.name: Older Student
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the?! What's with your speed?!
You're like a totally different
person now!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is it!
I just needed to lower my center
of gravity and drive my feet
into the
ground!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
From now on, this technique'll be called
my "slashing style"! I just need to
concentrate all my power into my feet and
push forward!
Raaargh!

text_block_list.name: Older Student
text_block_list.text: I... lost... to this complete amateur...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I did it! ...Hey,
thanks for racing against
me! You're seriously a tough
opponent.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet again... in the Twinkle Series.
With your skills, I'm sure
you'll easily climb
to the top.

text_block_list.name: Older Student
text_block_list.text: Vodka, you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The end of summer camp rolls around, and
with it came the summer
festival. After the
festivities, I find Vodka again.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, festivals are great. I sold tons,
too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I ate a bit, but I was also super busy
serving up food. I was helping
out at one
of the yakisoba places.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Did ya know that I'm actually super good
at making noodles? When I
was little, my
pops's buddy let me help out at his street
stall.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But that's beside the point, isn't it?
Trainer, thanks for helpin' me out
during
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And as for the type of coolness that I
wanna aim for—I think it finally clicked.
That beach race made me realize that it's
okay to have both
types.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can borrow from both my pops's
coolness and my mom's
strength.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll be the coolest runner who never
loses! And when I win, that's when
I'll drop my
cool one-liners! That way, I'll never come
off as a sore loser.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's easier said than done,
but
I got this!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I got this baseless confidence from
my pops. Oh, speaking of
which, my mom
told me a story about him.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It was about his reckless confidence. Back
before they started going
out...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pops confessed his love to Mom during the
summer festival.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At the time, Mom was a rising star and
busy as any racer could ever
be. Pops, on
the other hand, was your run-of-the-mill
guy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Do you wanna guess why my mom agreed
to date him?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorta, but not quite. Apparently, Pops
started saying all kinds of
stuff. Like how
he'd become famous, or how he'd make
her the happiest person alive.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My mom thought it was funny how he talked himself up that much. He pretty much got her to say yes through sheer grit.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I got my heart from my pops, and
my legs from my mom.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's just who I am! And with both of
these strengths combined, no
challenge is
too great for me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because I've gotten a hell of a lot
stronger
since meeting you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I used to get all flustered just
hearin' love stories, but now
I'm totally
fine... I think...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it...
Mom said that after
she agreed to date Pops,
they rode his
motorcycle home together.)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Riding tandem, huh... What if I went back
to the dorm with Trainer
like that?)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you'll give me a ride? Hop on?
O-okay... Don't mind if I do...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? Grab onto your waist? I-if you
say so...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Bfgldskdf!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah,
I-I'm totally fine. Th-this is 'cause,
um...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate bananas! That's it! I ate too
many chocolate bananas
earlier! Believe
me, damn it!
